name: nanoclaw
tagline_zh: 嫌 OpenClaw 太重？纳米爪轻装上线，容器隔离更安全，直连 WhatsApp 等六端，自带记忆和定时任务。
tagline_en: Tired of heavy agents? Nanoclaw is a lightweight, container-secured OpenClaw alternative—connects 6+ chat apps.
desc_en: A lightweight alternative to OpenClaw that runs in containers for security. Connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Gmail and other messaging apps,, has memory, scheduled jobs, and runs directly on Anthropic's Agents SDK
why_zh: 同类靠插件堆功能，它靠容器隔离保安全，且直接跑在 Anthropic 官方 SDK 上，轻量不妥协。
why_en: Unlike rivals bloated with plugins, it secures via containers and runs natively on Anthropic's SDK—lightweight without cutting.
